versions.content: If CanIf_ErrorNotification() is called by CanDrv , the function shall evaluate whether a Rx related error was detected. If this is the case the CanIf shall report the security event CANIF_SEV_RX_ERROR_DETECTED . The context data is structured as follows: Context Data (2 Byte) • ControllerID (1 Byte) • CanError (1 Byte) – CAN_ERROR_CHECK_FORM_FAILED (0x8) – CAN_ERROR_CHECK_STUFFING_FAILED (0x9) – CAN_ERROR_CHECK_CRC_FAILED (0xA) – CAN_ERROR_BUS_LOCK (0xB)
